pr_body:
Adjustments to the MockTerminal class in #86198 and elsewhere have broken tests that depended on specific line endings. In many cases, this was not what the test was actually trying to check for. This fix makes the strings as system-agnostic as possible, in several cases using the `String#lines` method to handle line endings in a system-agnostic way.

Closes #86294. Closes #86341
pr_title: Fix test for Windows line endings
pr_comment: I pushed some more fixes to this branch since the problem is causing a lot of build failures.
Since the failure here is unrelated, I'm going to go ahead and merge. I'll follow up tomorrow with muting if anything isn't working as planned.

review_comment: This seems like a place where we do actually care about the newline. Using `lines()` would mask if we were not printing any newline at all. Could we still assert the length?
